# British Theatre Playhouse

> Official website: https://britishtheatreplayhouse.com
> Official current show: https://britishtheatreplayhouse.com/londons-west-end-rising-stars/
> Contact: producers@britishtheatreplayhouse.com

British Theatre Playhouse is a professional theatre production company incorporated in Singapore in 2004. It is internationally focused with a strong British connection.

## Current production
London’s West End Rising Stars – East Meets West in Musical Theatre

### Kuala Lumpur
- Date: 21 October 2026
- Venue: Hilton Kuala Lumpur, Grand Ballroom
- Format: dinner-theatre experience with a curated 4-course meal before the show

### Singapore
- Date: 24 October 2026
- Venue: Capitol Theatre
- Afternoon Matinee: 2:00 PM
- Art for Charity Gala: 7:00 PM

## Announced talent
Miranda Wilford, Christine Allado, Aaron Teoh, Louis Djilbril Thiam
